name: Healing tonic
description: A doctor's tonic of herbs and something stronger: it puts strength back in a tired body.

name: Fever cure
description: Powders that break a fever and most of what comes with one.

name: Bone salve
description: A thick salve and a splint: bones knit a month sooner.

name: Battle stimulant
description: A doctor's injection that keeps a fighter on their feet a little longer than they should be.

name: Vigor draught
description: A bitter draught a good doctor brews from rare herbs: for a few months, the body has more to give.

name: Peg leg
description: A good wooden leg, fitted by someone who knew what they were doing.

name: Iron arm
description: A jointed arm of iron and leather, strapped to the shoulder.

name: Glass eye
description: It does not see, but it looks like it might.

name: Cyborg frame
description: Iron bones, cola-fired joints and a body rebuilt by your own hands. Only a shipwright with a death wish and a genius would try.

name: Leather jerkin
description: Boiled leather over the chest and shoulders: it turns a glancing blade.

name: Chain shirt
description: Rings of iron under a coat. Heavy, and a fine way to drown.

name: Samurai armour
description: Lacquered plates laced with silk, made for war in Wano.

name: Officer's coat
description: A white coat with Justice across the back, worn over the shoulders.

name: Captain's coat
description: A long coat with brass buttons, the kind a crew follows.

name: Fine clothes
description: A tailor's best: silk, a good cut, and doors that open.

name: Hearty stew
description: A pot of stew that would put meat on anyone's bones.

name: Sea king steak
description: A slab of sea king, seared hard: a fighter's meal.

name: A sailor's feast
description: Fish, meat and fruit cooked by someone who cares: a crew eats it and feels it for months.

name: Healing broth
description: A legendary cook's broth for the sick: it heals as surely as a doctor.

name: Treasure map
description: A map with an X on it. Some are real.

name: Marine warship plan
description: The Marines' own plan for a battleship, stolen or sold out of a dockyard. With it, a big enough yard can build one.

name: Galley-La caravel plan
description: A Water 7 masterwork: a caravel drawn by the best shipwrights alive, quick, tough and long-lived.

name: Treasure-tree galleon plan
description: A master shipwright's dream: a galleon of Adam wood, with a burner, a burst system and rooms for a crew to live in.
